name: Buhrmaster Family Farm

description: Buhrmaster Family Farm is an Christmas tree farm in Scotia, NY. Visitors come for Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Flowers, and Christmas trees, best in summer. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Apr – Jun in this growing zone.
